[P2] Return the public behavior change to the design phase

Changing `deserialize` from reading the supplied pointer to selecting another file changes its public contract. CONTRIBUTING rule 3 requires a design note even for API-changing bug fixes. The description explains the chosen implementation but still provides neither the required comparison of alternatives nor a reference to an agreed design note. Return to the design phase (rule 8, step 6), document the supported producer identities and compatibility policy, and obtain maintainer agreement.
